title: Providence of the Trinity for the three royal children
english: For the sake of the royal children of the same race, Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, the providence of the holy Trinity worked through the reading from Daniel that was just proclaimed. About these I wish to explain to the Church of God their way of life, their advocacy, their alliance, and their perfection—how these good noble offspring, the children, proved their courage and were brought to perfection.

orientation: Cyril is addressing the congregation about the three young men, Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, and now states that the providence of the holy Trinity worked for their sake through the prophecy just read.

title: Cyril's own record of the children's symbol and perfection
english: I, Cyril, the least bishop of the city of Alexandria, encountered this account of the good testament in the book of Daniel. I wrote down the symbol, way of life, advocacy, and alliance of the holy and blameless children, and their perfection in Christ.

title: Closing prayer for the Church's flourishing through the martyrs' intercession
english: May it happen by the grace of Christ and through the intercession of the victorious martyrs just remembered, that the Church of Christ flourishes and advances, thriving in the fruit of righteousness. May fathers and mothers produce such children with self-control and godliness, and may young men and virgins be counted worthy of such a way of life and be united in such virtue. The holy children are perfected on the seventeenth of December.
